info.title: Uniwise API
info.description: Deterministic accommodation and commute decision engine for students moving to Glasgow.

ensuite.title: Ensuite
ensuite.description: null = not stated by the source.

accessible.title: Accessible
accessible.description: true only where the source names an accessible room.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Availability is never published by the source, so it is always unknown.

monthly_rent_equivalent_gbp.title: Monthly Rent Equivalent Gbp
monthly_rent_equivalent_gbp.description: Weekly rent normalised to an average calendar month (x 52 / 12).

AccommodationOption.title: AccommodationOption
AccommodationOption.description: One bookable room type in one residence, as published by the source.

note.title: Note
note.description: How to read the list: schemes are potential benefits, not confirmed entitlements.

max_monthly_budget_gbp.title: Max Monthly Budget Gbp
max_monthly_budget_gbp.description: Maximum monthly rent + bills + commute, in GBP.

budget_is_hard.title: Budget Is Hard
budget_is_hard.description: If true, options over budget are excluded.

max_upfront_gbp.title: Max Upfront Gbp
max_upfront_gbp.description: Always a hard limit when set.

commute_is_hard.title: Commute Is Hard
commute_is_hard.description: If true, options over the commute limit are excluded.

monthly_total_gbp.title: Monthly Total Gbp
monthly_total_gbp.description: null when any recurring component is unknown.

amount_gbp.title: Amount Gbp
amount_gbp.description: null = unknown. Zero means genuinely zero or included elsewhere.

normalised.title: Normalised
normalised.description: 0-1, higher is better. null when the value is missing.

Priorities.title: Priorities
Priorities.description: Relative importance, 0-10. A zero weight removes the factor entirely.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0-100 overall fit relative to the other feasible options.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of ranked options returned.

recommendation_id.title: Recommendation Id
recommendation_id.description: Deterministic hash of the request and dataset versions.

total_feasible.title: Total Feasible
total_feasible.description: Room-and-transport combinations that met every hard constraint.

StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: The Glasgow Student Twin: the structured circumstances the engine personalises against.
